info.title: Agent Event Protocol (AEP) API
info.description:
HTTP API for ingesting, querying, and exporting structured agent telemetry events under the Agent Event Protocol specification.

## API Versioning

All consumer-facing endpoints are available under the `/v1` prefix (e.g. `POST /v1/events`). The unversioned root paths (e.g. `POST /events`) remain active for backward compatibility. Every response includes an `API-Version: 1` header. Infrastructure endpoints (`/health`, `/ready`, `/metrics/prometheus`) and the dashboard UI are **not** versioned.

## Authentication

Most endpoints require an **API key** passed as a bearer token:
```
Authorization: Bearer aep_<48-hex-chars>
```
Keys are created via the Admin API and are scoped to either `read` or `write` (or both).

Admin endpoints require a separate **admin token** set in the `ADMIN_TOKEN` environment variable.

AdminAuth.description: Admin token set via the ADMIN_TOKEN environment variable

AnomalyReport.description: Workflow anomaly report (Phase 15-D). Traces are flagged by the robust modified-z (median/MAD) rule against the per-tenant cross-trace baseline.

scale.description: Robust dispersion (≈ stddev) from MAD or mean-AD.

value_threshold.description: Raw-value cutoff; null when the baseline is not stable.

stable.description: False when too few traces or zero spread; such a metric never flags.

anomalies.description: Flagged traces, most anomalous first (capped at `limit`).

WorkflowGraph.description: Event-level causation graph spanning all sessions of a trace (Phase 15-C).

edge_count.description: Causation edges where both endpoints are in the graph.

cross_session_edge_count.description: Of those, the edges whose two events belong to different sessions.

sessions.description: Per-session summary, ordered by first event time.

root_ids.description: Events with no in-graph causation parent.

QuerySpec.description: A safe, structured custom-analytics query (NOT SQL). Field references are whitelist-validated: a top-level event field (type, source, session_id, trace_id, parent_session_id, causation_id, agent_role, subject, time, id, tenant) or a `payload.*` / `labels.*` / `extensions.*` dot-path. The segments `__proto__`, `prototype`, `constructor` are rejected.

value.description: Scalar for most ops; an array for `in`/`nin`; omitted for `exists`/`not_exists`.

time_bucket.description: Optional extra group dimension bucketing event time (`_bucket`).

aggregations.description: A `count` is always included. `count_distinct` requires a `field`.

since.description: Inclusive lower bound on event time.

until.description: Exclusive upper bound on event time.

rows.description: One row per group, ranked by count descending then group-key ascending.

group.description: Resolved group_by field values (plus `_bucket` when time_bucket is set).

distinct.description: Per count_distinct field, the number of distinct values in the group.

truncated.description: True when more groups existed than `limit`.

target_url.description: Delivery target (http/https; SSRF-guarded — private/loopback/link-local hosts are rejected).

event_types.description: Event-type filter: ["*"] for all events, or a subset of the core event types.

enabled.description: A disabled webhook is retained but receives no deliveries.

WebhookDelivery.description: One (event → webhook) delivery attempt set, with its terminal outcome.

attempts.description: Number of HTTP attempts made (1 + retries).

last_status_code.description: Last HTTP status (null on network error / timeout / SSRF rejection).

last_error.description: Short diagnostic for the last failure (null on success).

LatencyStats.description: Latency percentile statistics over a set of operation durations (milliseconds). Percentiles use the nearest-rank method, so each is an actually-observed sample.

count.description: Number of operations in the group

key.description: The group key (tool name / source / session / operation type)

AuditBundle.description: Tamper-evident, HMAC-signed audit bundle (Phase 14). Verify offline with the `aep audit verify` CLI or the SDK verifier.

manifest.description: Signed manifest. content_digest covers the ordered events; the signature covers the manifest (and thus, transitively, the events).

value.description: base64 HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical manifest

parent_session_id.description: Session ID of the spawning parent agent. Absent for root or standalone sessions.

agent_role.description: Role of the agent in the execution hierarchy.

causation_id.description: ID of the event that caused this event.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-supplied deduplication key. If set, the server deduplicates by this key instead of `id`.

schema.description: URI reference to the schema for the payload.

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature envelope used when the API key has a configured hmac_secret.

tenant.description: Optional tenant hint in the envelope (informational only; data isolation is enforced by the API key).

labels.description: Arbitrary string key/value pairs for filtering and routing.

extensions.description: Extension fields beyond the core envelope.

payload.description: Event-specific data. May include an optional `$schema` key for payload validation.

$schema.description: URI reference to a JSON Schema for validating this payload.

retentionDays.description: Retention policy in days; null = unlimited

region.description: Declared data-residency region; null = unspecified (Phase 14 PR-G)

regionEnforced.description: Whether this deployment's DATA_RESIDENCY_REGION satisfies the project's declared region (false = data not physically in the required region; AEP does not route storage by region)

usage.description: Current accepted-event count for the project's tenant (list/get only)

message.example: Signature must use v2 canonical form. Upgrade your AEP SDK.

detail.description: Kept for backward compatibility; identical to message

Forbidden.description: API key lacks the required scope

servers.description: Root only — /health is an infra probe, not versioned under /v1

post.description: Accepts a single AEP envelope, validates it against the schema and registered event types, and persists it. Duplicate `id` values are silently accepted and flagged as `duplicate: true`.

200.description: Duplicate event — already ingested, accepted idempotently

400.description: Event failed schema or type validation

401.description: Missing API key, or HMAC signature verification failed

429.description: Rate limit hit, or the key's project has reached its event quota. The `Retry-After` header indicates when to retry.

quota.description: The project's event quota (quota responses only)

get.description: Returns all sessions for the authenticated tenant, ordered by most-recently-updated first.
Returns the ordered event timeline for a session, optionally filtered by type or full-text search.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter to a specific event type (e.g. `tool.called`)

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Full-text search string matched against the raw event JSON

get.summary: Get session and all descendant sessions as a tree
Export session events as JSON or CSV

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Export format — `json` (default) or `csv`

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Optional event-type filter

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Optional full-text search filter

200.description: Session events in the requested format

get.summary: Build a signed, tamper-evident audit bundle for a session
get.description: Returns an HMAC-signed audit bundle of the session's events (Phase 14). Requires AUDIT_SIGNING_SECRET to be configured server-side; returns 503 if it is not.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format — `json` (default, the verifiable bundle) or `pdf` (a human-readable report rendering; the JSON bundle remains the tamper-evident artifact). Unrecognized values return JSON.

200.description: Signed audit bundle (JSON) or its PDF report rendering, per `format`

get.summary: Get all sessions sharing a trace_id as a workflow tree
Cross-session causation graph for a trace
get.description: Assembles the event-level causation graph spanning every session of a trace: nodes (projected events), causation edges classified as intra- vs cross-session, the per-session summary, and the root events. Read- + tenant-scoped; 404 if the trace has no sessions for the tenant (same as the workflow tree). Powers the dashboard's interactive cross-session DAG.

get.summary: Build a signed, tamper-evident audit bundle for a whole trace
get.description: Returns an HMAC-signed audit bundle of all events across every session sharing the trace_id (Phase 14). Requires AUDIT_SIGNING_SECRET to be configured server-side; returns 503 if it is not.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format — `json` (default, the verifiable bundle) or `pdf` (a human-readable report rendering; the JSON bundle remains the tamper-evident artifact). Unrecognized values return JSON.

200.description: Signed audit bundle (JSON) or its PDF report rendering, per `format`

get.description: Aggregates `policy.blocked` events for the authenticated tenant — what the agent refused to do, and when. Results are tenant-scoped from the API key.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on event time (`time >= since`). ISO-8601.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on event time (`time < until`). ISO-8601.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum entries in the `recent` list (1-1000, default 20).

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format. `json` (default) returns the full analytics summary object. `csv` returns RFC-4180 CSV with one row per recent event (columns: id, time, source, session_id, trace_id, agent_role, policy, reason, action_blocked).

by_source.description: Counts grouped by event `source`, ranked descending.

by_day.description: Counts per calendar day (the date prefix of event time; the UTC day for Z-normalized timestamps), ascending.

recent.description: Most-recent-first projection of the matching events.

400.description: Invalid query parameter (e.g. a non-ISO `since`/`until`, or `limit` outside 1-1000)

get.description: Pairs lifecycle events into operations (`tool.called`→`tool.result`, `task.created`→`task.completed`|`task.failed`, matched by the end event's `causation_id`) and reports p50/p95/p99 latency — computed from event `time` fields — sliced by tool, agent (`source`), session, and operation type. Results are tenant-scoped from the API key. An operation is counted only when both its start and end events fall inside the window; end events whose start is missing/out-of-window are reported in `unmatched_ends`.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on event time (`time >= since`). ISO-8601.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on event time (`time < until`). ISO-8601.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum entries in the `slowest` list (1-1000, default 20).

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format. `json` (default) returns the full profiling summary object. `csv` returns RFC-4180 CSV with one row per slowest operation (columns: kind, op_type, name, source, session_id, trace_id, status, duration_ms, started_at, ended_at).

unmatched_ends.description: End events with no locatable in-window start (or a negative duration), skipped

overall.description: Latency stats over all operations; null when there are none.

by_tool.description: Latency stats for tool operations grouped by tool name, ranked by count descending.

by_agent.description: Latency stats grouped by agent `source`, ranked by count descending.

by_session.description: Latency stats grouped by `session_id`, ranked by count descending.

by_operation.description: Latency stats grouped by operation type (e.g. `tool.called→tool.result`), ranked by count descending.

slowest.description: The slowest operations, descending by duration (capped at `limit`).

name.description: Tool name for tool operations; null for task operations.

400.description: Invalid query parameter (e.g. a non-ISO `since`/`until`, or `limit` outside 1-1000)

get.description: Flags workflows (traces) whose error-rate, policy.blocked volume, or latency deviates from the per-tenant cross-trace baseline by more than `threshold` robust modified-z (median/MAD) — "alert when a workflow deviates from expected patterns". A metric only flags when its baseline is stable (at least 3 traces and non-zero spread). Read- + tenant-scoped.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on event time (`time >= since`). ISO-8601.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on event time (`time < until`). ISO-8601.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: Modified-z cutoff (> 0, default 3.5; smaller is more sensitive).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum anomalies returned (1-1000, default 50).

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format. `json` (default) returns the full anomaly report object. `csv` returns RFC-4180 CSV with one row per anomalous trace (columns: trace_id, max_score, severity, metrics, flags); nested objects are JSON-stringified.

400.description: Invalid query parameter (non-ISO since/until, non-positive threshold, or limit outside 1-1000)

post.description: Runs a safe, structured user-defined query (filters + group_by + aggregations + window) over the tenant's event stream. The body is a query **spec**, never SQL: field references are whitelist-validated (top-level fields, or `payload.*` / `labels.*` / `extensions.*` dot-paths with a prototype-pollution guard) and all execution happens in pure JS over the tenant-scoped events. Read- + tenant-scoped.

400.description: Invalid query spec (unknown/forbidden field, bad operator, out-of-range limit, …). Includes a `details` array.

get.description: Lists the authenticated tenant's saved query library (newest first). Read- + tenant-scoped.

post.description: Persists a named query to the tenant's library. Requires a **write**-scoped key (it mutates tenant data). The spec is validated before storage.

400.description: Missing/too-long name, or invalid query spec

409.description: A saved query with this name already exists for the tenant

delete.description: Removes a saved query. Requires a **write**-scoped key.

post.summary: Run a saved query by id
post.description: Loads the tenant's saved query and runs it. The stored spec is re-validated defensively before execution. Read- + tenant-scoped.

200.description: Query result, with a reference to the saved query that produced it

422.description: The stored spec is no longer valid

get.description: Lists the authenticated tenant's webhooks (newest first). Read- + tenant-scoped.

post.description: Registers an outbound webhook. Requires a **write**-scoped key. The `target_url` is validated by the SSRF guard (loopback / private / link-local / non-http(s) targets are rejected); self-hosters can permit specific private targets via the `WEBHOOK_TARGET_ALLOWLIST` env var. `event_types` defaults to `["*"]` (all events). The 201 response includes a one-time `signing_secret` — store it; it is NEVER returned again. Deliveries are HMAC-SHA256 signed with it and carry an `X-AEP-Signature: hmac-sha256=<base64>` header (verify over the raw request body).

201.description: The registered webhook, including its one-time `signing_secret` (shown only here).

signing_secret.description: Per-webhook HMAC signing secret. Returned ONCE at creation; store it securely — it is never returned again.

400.description: Invalid target URL (incl. SSRF-blocked host), event-type filter, or enabled flag

patch.description: Partially updates a webhook (`target_url`, `event_types`, and/or `enabled`). Requires a **write**-scoped key. A changed `target_url` is re-validated by the SSRF guard.

400.description: Invalid fields (incl. SSRF-blocked host), or no updatable field provided

delete.description: Removes a webhook. Requires a **write**-scoped key.

get.description: Recent delivery attempts for a webhook (newest first), each with its terminal status, attempt count, last HTTP status code, and last error. Read- + tenant-scoped; 404 if the webhook isn't this tenant's.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Inclusive ISO-8601 lower bound on created_at.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Exclusive ISO-8601 upper bound on created_at.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max rows (1–1000, default 100).

get.description: Maps AEP's live evidence (HMAC-signed audit bundles, the API-key access log, policy.blocked analytics, tenant isolation + key scopes, retention, the causation-linked event store) onto the control areas of SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, or the EU AI Act. Each control's status (`satisfied` / `partial` / `unmet`) is derived from the actual configuration. Read-scoped + tenant-scoped. This is an input to a compliance review, not a certification.

parameters.name: framework
parameters.description: Which framework to report against.

parameters.name: session
parameters.description: Optional integrity proof-point: build + verify an audit bundle for this session. Mutually exclusive with `trace`.

parameters.name: trace
parameters.description: Optional integrity proof-point: build + verify an audit bundle for this trace. Mutually exclusive with `session`.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Inclusive ISO-8601 lower bound for the policy-enforcement evidence.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Exclusive ISO-8601 upper bound for the policy-enforcement evidence.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `json` (default) or `pdf` (a human-readable rendering).

200.description: Compliance report (JSON), or a PDF rendering when `format=pdf`.

400.description: Missing/invalid `framework`, both `session` and `trace` given, or a non-ISO `since`/`until`

get.summary: Server-Sent Events stream of real-time ingest activity
get.description: Subscribes the caller to an SSE stream. On each accepted `POST /events`, an `event.received` SSE message is pushed. A `: heartbeat` comment is sent every 15 seconds to keep the connection alive.

projectId.description: Project the key is bound to (must exist). Defaults to 'default' (unlimited).

hmacSecret.description: If provided, all events ingested with this key must carry a valid HMAC-SHA256 signature.

201.description: API key created. The raw key is shown once and cannot be retrieved again.

503.description: Admin API is not enabled (ADMIN_TOKEN not set)

get.description: Returns all API keys. Raw key values and HMAC secrets are never included.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the API key to revoke

get.description: Returns the most-recent-first access records for one API key (Phase 14 PR-E). Recording is opt-in via the `ACCESS_LOG_ENABLED` env var; `enabled` reflects its current state, so an empty log with `enabled:false` means logging is off, not that the key was unused.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the API key

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on record time (`ts >= since`). ISO-8601.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on record time (`ts < until`). ISO-8601.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum entries returned (1-1000, default 100).

path.description: URL pathname only (never the query string)

post.summary: Create a project on a subscription tier
post.description: Creates a project. The named tier's default event quota and retention are materialised onto the project row; either may be overridden per-project. A project is the unit that carries quota/retention; API keys bind to it.

eventQuota.description: Override the tier's default event quota. null = unlimited.

retentionDays.description: Override the tier's default retention. null = unlimited.

region.description: Declared data-residency region (Phase 14 PR-G). Omit for unspecified.

get.summary: Get a single project (with current usage)

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Project id
